paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores, representing the frequency of different sentiment scores. The x-axis is labeled "Polarity scores" with a linear scale, ranging from -1.1 to 0.6, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "Counts" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50,000, and tick labels at intervals of 10,000. A single blue line with circular markers and a solid style represents the data, starting at approximately 480 counts at a polarity score of -1.1, remaining relatively stable until -0.5, then increasing to around 5,000 counts at -0.4 before decreasing slightly to about 3,000 counts at -0.3; it then rises to 10,000 counts at -0.2, followed by a sharp increase to 50,000 counts at 0.0, before declining to 25,000 counts at 0.1 and further to 2,000 counts at 0.4, with a slight increase to 10,000 counts at 0.45, and then finally decreasing to 1,000 counts at 0.6.
